subject: Different results when using semTools::efa.ekc and EFAtools::EKC

messages.author: e28c2a6271e61e56
messages.subject: Different results when using semTools::efa.ekc and EFAtools::EKC
parts:
Hi all,

I want to determine the number of factors for a dataset with 147 variables and 562 cases. Therefore I used the semTools::efa.ekc and the EFAtools::EKC functions that both are supposed to determine the number of factors based on (10.1037/met0000074). However, the two functions come to very different results:
semTools::efa.ekc(sample.cov=df.pcs$r, sample.nobs = df.pcs$n) # 56 factors
EFAtools::EKC(x=df.pcs$r, N=df.pcs$n) # 9 factors
Sidenote: As my data is quite skewed, I used polychoric correlations and used a smoothing algorithm (10.1007/S11336-010-9191-3, fungible::smoothBY) , as the matrix was not positive definite.
Does anyone has an idea why the two functions produce such different results? The data set (correlation matrix and n) is attached.

Best wishes,
Phil
